_parameter_provenance.notes: Downforce splits across front and rear axles via aero_balance_front (or optional explicit cl_a_front / cl_a_rear): cl_a_front = cl_a * aero_balance_front, cl_a_rear = cl_a * (1 - aero_balance_front), producing real aerodynamic pitching moment around CoG, modulated by front/rear ground ride height.
